lines: Kirara
Wh-What's going on here...? We were in a subway tunnel until a second ago...
Me
B-Beats me...
Kirara-senpai and I looked at each other, completely unable to understand what was going on.
Until just a few moments earlier, we had definitely been running through a subway tunnel.
But―that tunnel had vanished in an instant, and now we were somewhere that looked like a cave.
Naturally, even when we looked back, the tunnel we had been running through before was nowhere to be seen.
There was only a strange cave that seemed to go on forever.
Me
(But wait―I remember this feeling!!)
I had been in a similar situation just recently.
In fact, the possibility of it had occurred to me after seeing us get teleported from the warehouse, as well as the endlessly appearing hordes of demonic creatures.
Me
(No doubt about it. That means that this space is―)
Then―
Demonic Creature
HROOOOOOAGH!!!
Me
Kirara
Again!? How far are they going to follow us!?
The space around us became distorted and a large number of demonic creatures sprang out.
But this was also a phenomenon I had seen before.
Kirara
Aaah, so frustrating!! I'm going to send every single one of them flying right here!!
Me
―Wait a second!! Fighting these guys is pointless!!
Kirara
Huh!? What do you mean "pointless"!?
I held back Kirara-senpai, who was about to engage the demonic creatures in battle.
Kirara-senpai could not seem to hide her irritation at the endlessly appearing hordes of demonic creatures―
But that was exactly what the "practitioner" who had set this spell was aiming for.
Me
This is probably a magic trap!! It's pointless if we don't take down the person who set it!!
It was probably a trap similar to the "Crossroad of Confusion" that I had encountered in the black market broker's store.
A magically sealed space and endlessly appearing demonic creatures―
If that was the case, then first we needed to look for the one who was controlling this horde of demonic creatures.
Me
We have to find the person who set this trap while keeping the demonic creatures in check! Listen here!! From now on, follow my instructions and...
Kirara
Huh!? No way! Who's gonna follow your instructions!?
Me
Eehh!!?
Th-This was way too different from what I was used to...
If it were Hebiko and Shikanosuke, they would have readily agreed to go along with my plan...
Gargoyle
HROOOOOAGH!!!
Me
Whoa!? Watch out!!
I raised my ninjato just in time and repelled the demonic creature's attack.
The circle of the creatures around us was getting smaller and smaller, and we had no more time left to spare.
Me
S-See!? This is not the time to be arguing!!! Please listen to what I say!
Kirara
No!! Absolutely not!!
Me
Why!? And for starters, why do you hate the very sight of me!?
Kirara
Th-That's... because I don't like what I don't like!!
Kirara
I can't tolerate listening to a man!!!!
Me
Ah!? Kirara-senpai―
Ignoring my attempts to stop her, Kirara-senpai rushed into battle.
